title: a cone side replaced by a cylinder, isoparametric curves and parameters of full tori, a variable fillet at a corner

cases.name: c001
cases.description: a cone frustum (radius 10 to 6, 20 tall): its side replaced by a coaxial cylinder of radius 8

cases.name: c002
cases.description: four isoparametric curves in the U direction on a full torus about z, and its parameters

cases.name: c003
cases.description: four in the V direction on the same torus

cases.name: c004
cases.description: four in the U direction on a full torus about x (the circle about (0, 20) in the xy plane revolved)

cases.name: c005
cases.description: a variable conic fillet (rho 0.7) of a block's top front and top right edges, meeting at a corner: 2 mm at the far ends, 4 mm at the corner
